*Try Abacus AI Deep Agent:* 👉 https://firstmovers.ai/DeepAgent

*AI just generated a 30-minute expert debate… with four distinct personalities… and it sounded real. No studio. No voice actors. No editing team.*

Podcasting, audiobooks, and audio ads have always required massive production overhead — hosts, engineers, studios, weeks of work. That barrier just collapsed.

In this sponsored DeepAgent walkthrough, you’ll see five real demonstrations:
• A landmark AI research paper turned into a polished audio overview
• A 30-minute AI safety debate with emotional, expressive voices
• A full two-host podcast created end-to-end from one prompt
• Audiobooks and audio ads generated at scale
• Realistic dialogue that feels uncomfortably human

This isn’t text-to-speech. It’s structured research, personality consistency, memory, emotional delivery, and full production pipelines — automated.

The economics of audio are changing fast.
